info.name: Oracle GoldenGate Veridata REST API
info.description:
REST API for Oracle GoldenGate Veridata, a data comparison and repair solution that verifies data consistency between source and target databases. Provides operations for managing connections, compare groups, compare pairs, jobs, profiles, monitoring comparison results, and repairing out-of-sync data. Based on Oracle GoldenGate Veridata 23c REST API documentation.

Contact Support:
 Name: Oracle Support
